scope: Body movement/animation consumer and existing attachment interfaces only. No object authoring.
findings: visualAnimation has no CHILD-specific locomotion branch: after death/skill/hurt/etc precedence, horizontal velocity squared > .001 chooses run if sprinting else walk, otherwise idle. Direction signed relative to facing is not used in this selector. Lateral/retreat travel therefore selects same key; this is source evidence, not a played visual diagnosis.

FLOATING selects playback rate1 for locomotion, and secondary cutoff24. It does not choose fly or set noGravity, body position, collision, head tracking or root bob. Fixed cadence may remain as horizontal speed changes; perceptual sliding not runtime observed.

Authored idle/walk/run root position keys are allzero; walk thigh±10/knee∓3/ankle∓7deg; run thigh±18/knee∓5.4/ankle∓12.6deg. Curse lifts chest by2model units at2sec rather than root. Death root is nonzero, so do not generalize no root movement to all clips.

TemplateMobModel routes CHILD to cod2_voxel geometry/animation/texture, calls super custom animations then shared secondary motion. There is no explicit CHILD head-target conversion in this local override; inherited GeckoLib targeting/render rotation is not fully read and cannot be ruled out.

TemplateSecondaryMotion was fully read. Its CHILD effect operates only lamp_inertia and ribbon_spring_0..2: capped7degree acceleration/turn spring rotation, lamp Y rotation=.7*roll0. No CHILD body/root height or leg correction. It resets wrapper transforms every draw and drops state when dead/far/world changes; not a floating-body solver.

TemplateMobRenderer whole: child no special actor lift in render/applyRotations; standard rotations delegate to super. Lantern_flame gets packedlight15728880 only. CHILD not special translucent/tint branch. A bright lamp or drifting ribbon cannot prove body hovering; item artwork remains other specialist scope.

Selected rearRoute resolves prior gap: searches radii3/4, offsets0,-1,1,-2,2 and dy0,1,2,-1,-2 behind normalized horizontal victim look, fallback+Z. Requires loaded chunk, empty feet fluid, sturdy support below, dimensions noCollision and reachable path. This reinforces terrain-constrained rear approach; does not grant flight or guarantee whole route native safety.

Controller adjustTick retains local transition tick when resetting/notRUNNING; active/death clips seek actionAge only when server start>=0. Locomotion stays local. Preserve40tick curse contact and existing seek behavior; do not slow/shift attack to make visual hovering.

Reread Spectre whole model: age-driven spine/tail/wing/root rotations independent of limb swing, interpolated velocity-derived pitch. root walk is Xrotation, not Ybob; no explicit root height channel. It supports separation of cosmetic rhythm from travel, not ground-safe child float clearance.

Reread Ghost selected setup: body forward lean clamped0..20deg; head/arms counterrotate, age-driven both legs same-phase walk plus bodybob; separate f/f1 movement bob also present. This is not a ready child backward-gait clip; Citadel bob helper not freshly read, exact amplitudes/sign and rendering height remain inherited unknown.
